title: mimosa distans subsp. elongata
intro:
Mimosa distans subsp. elongata, commonly known as the sensitive plant or mimosa, is a perennial herb native to the Americas. It is known for its ability to fold its leaves in response to touch, and it is prized for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The therapeutic actions of mimosa distans subsp. elongata include its use as a vasodilator, to reduce anxiety and stress, and as an antispasmodic to alleviate muscle cramps. 

The bioactive constituents of mimosa distans subsp. elongata include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
